item.title: Charlotte man enters Alford plea in Montgomery County court for the murder of Allisha Watts
item.description: According to court records, 52-year-old James Wendell Dunmore pleaded guilty under Alford to voluntary manslaughter and failure to report a death by other than natural causes.

item.title: 1 in hospital with life-threatening injuries after crash in Asheboro on West Dixie Drive
item.description: ASHEBORO, N.C. (WGHP) -- One person was taken to the hospital with life-threatening injuries after a crash in Asheboro on Wednesday evening, according to Randolph County EMS. The crash happened on the 700 block of West Dixie Drive. The cause of the crash is unknown at this time. This is a developing story.
